questions.prompt: Ms. Tan is used to ___ long hours.
questions.explanation: be used to + V-ing：習慣於…（to 是介系詞）。注意 used to + V 是「過去常常」。

optionNotes.work: be used to 的 to 是介系詞，要接 V-ing；used to work（沒有 be）才是「過去常工作」

optionNotes.works: 介系詞後面不接第三人稱動詞

questions.prompt: The client ___ the contract yet.

questions.prompt: Ms. Tan is the manager ___ team won the award.

optionNotes.whom: whom 是受格，不表示所有
optionNotes.which: which 指事物，而且不表示所有

questions.prompt: Please ___ the attached file and let me know your thoughts.
questions.explanation: Please + 原形動詞（祈使句）。

optionNotes.to review: Please 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to

questions.prompt: The seminar was attended by ___ than 200 people.

questions.prompt: ___ having little experience, he was hired as a team leader.

questions.prompt: What does "lobby" mean?
questions.explanation: lobby（n.）大廳。例：Let's meet in the hotel lobby.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「製造商」.
questions.explanation: manufacturer（n.）製造商。例：Contact the manufacturer for repairs.

questions.prompt: What does "mention" mean?
questions.explanation: mention（v.）提到。例：She mentioned that the meeting was canceled.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「修改」.
questions.explanation: modify（v.）修改。例：We modified the design based on your feedback.

questions.prompt: What does "notify" mean?
questions.explanation: notify（v.）通知。例：We will notify you when your order ships.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「入住率；使用率」.
questions.explanation: occupancy（n.）入住率；使用率。例：The hotel's occupancy rate is 90%.

questions.prompt: What does "operate" mean?
questions.explanation: operate（v.）操作；營運。例：Only trained staff may operate this machine.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「外包」.
questions.explanation: outsource（v.）外包。例：Many companies outsource their IT support.

questions.prompt: What does "patron" mean?
questions.explanation: patron（n.）顧客；贊助人。例：The restaurant thanks all its loyal patrons.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「許可證」.
questions.explanation: permit（n.）許可證。例：You need a permit to park here.

questions.prompt: What does "portfolio" mean?
questions.explanation: portfolio（n.）作品集；投資組合。例：Please bring your portfolio to the interview.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「生產力」.
questions.explanation: productivity（n.）生產力。例：The new tools increased our productivity.

questions.prompt: What does "recruit" mean?
questions.explanation: recruit（v.）招募。例：We are recruiting new staff for the store.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「推薦人；參考」.
questions.explanation: reference（n.）推薦人；參考。例：Please list two references on your application.

questions.prompt: What does "reliable" mean?
questions.explanation: reliable（adj.）可靠的。例：We need a reliable delivery service.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「代表；業務員」.
questions.explanation: representative（n.）代表；業務員。例：A sales representative will call you soon.

questions.prompt: What does "requirement" mean?
questions.explanation: requirement（n.）要求；必要條件。例：A degree is a requirement for this job.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「修訂」.
questions.explanation: revise（v.）修訂。例：Please revise the report before Friday.

questions.prompt: What does "spacious" mean?
questions.explanation: spacious（adj.）寬敞的。例：The new office is bright and spacious.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「訂閱」.
questions.explanation: subscription（n.）訂閱。例：My magazine subscription ends in May.

questions.prompt: What does "testimonial" mean?
questions.explanation: testimonial（n.）（顧客）推薦見證；好評。例：Our website shows testimonials from happy customers.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「及時的」.
questions.explanation: timely（adj.）及時的。例：Thank you for your timely response.

questions.prompt: Please submit the form ___ 5 p.m. on Friday.
questions.explanation: no later than + 時間：最晚在…之前（= by）。

optionNotes.no sooner than: no sooner than 是「不早於」，意思相反
optionNotes.as late as: as late as 是「晚到…」，語意不通
optionNotes.until then: until then 是「到那時之前」，後面不能再接時間

questions.prompt: The CEO will ___ the new strategy at the annual meeting.
questions.explanation: will + 原形動詞。

optionNotes.announcement: 名詞，will 後面要接動詞

questions.prompt: The hotel is ___ to the airport, so it is popular with business travelers.
questions.explanation: be close to：離…很近（close 當形容詞）。

optionNotes.closely: 副詞「密切地」，is 後面要接形容詞

questions.prompt: Ms. Park has been working on the project ___ last March.
questions.explanation: 現在完成（進行）式 + since + 過去時間點。

optionNotes.during: during 接一段期間，不搭配完成式表示起點

questions.prompt: The marketing team, ___ includes five designers, is on the third floor.
questions.explanation: 逗號後的非限定子句，先行詞 team（看作一個整體）→ which。

optionNotes.who: 這裡把 team 當作一個單位（includes 單數），用 which
optionNotes.what: what 不能當關係代名詞修飾先行詞

questions.prompt: Each department must submit ___ budget by Monday.
questions.explanation: Each department（單數）→ 所有格用 its。

optionNotes.their: each 是單數，正式文法用 its
optionNotes.theirs: 所有格代名詞不能放在名詞前

questions.prompt: We need to hire someone ___ can speak both English and Japanese.
questions.explanation: 先行詞是人，在子句中當主詞 → who。

optionNotes.whom: whom 是受格，這裡需要主詞

questions.prompt: The report was so long ___ nobody finished reading it.
questions.explanation: so + 形容詞 + that…：如此…以致於…

optionNotes.as: as 用於 as … as 比較

questions.prompt: If the weather ___ good tomorrow, the picnic will be held outdoors.
questions.explanation: 條件句 if 子句用現在式表示未來。

optionNotes.were: were 用於與現在事實相反的假設

questions.prompt: The manager had his assistant ___ the meeting room.
questions.explanation: have + 人 + 原形動詞：叫某人去做…

optionNotes.prepared: have + 物 + p.p. 才用過去分詞（have the room prepared）
optionNotes.to prepare: have 是使役動詞，後面不加 to
optionNotes.preparing: 使役動詞 have 後面接人時用原形

questions.prompt: The contract needs to ___ by both parties.
questions.explanation: 合約「被」簽 → needs to be signed（被動）。

optionNotes.sign: 主動語態，合約不會自己簽
optionNotes.signed: to 後面不接過去分詞（少了 be）

questions.prompt: She is one of the most ___ employees in the company.
questions.explanation: the most + 形容詞 + 名詞。

questions.prompt: The meeting will begin ___ everyone has arrived.
questions.explanation: once + 子句：一旦…就…

optionNotes.despite: despite 後面接名詞，且語意不通

questions.prompt: Mr. Chen asked me ___ I could finish the report by Friday.
questions.explanation: 間接問句（是否…）→ whether / if。

optionNotes.that: ask 後面不接 that 子句表示疑問
optionNotes.what: what 後面的子句要缺少受詞
optionNotes.which: which 需要先行詞或選擇對象

questions.prompt: The new employees ___ by the HR manager yesterday.
questions.explanation: 新員工「被」訓練 + yesterday → 過去式被動。

optionNotes.trained: 主動語態，語意變成新員工去訓練別人
optionNotes.have trained: 主動，且現在完成式不搭配 yesterday
optionNotes.are training: 現在進行式不搭配 yesterday

questions.prompt: Our sales increased ___ the holiday season.
questions.explanation: during + 名詞（一段期間）：在…期間。

optionNotes.while: while 是連接詞，後面接子句
optionNotes.since: since 表示起點，要搭配完成式
optionNotes.among: among 是「在…之中（三者以上）」

questions.prompt: The seminar was canceled ___ a lack of interest.
questions.explanation: due to + 名詞：由於…

optionNotes.because: because 後面接子句（because of 才接名詞）
optionNotes.although: although 表示讓步，且接子句

questions.prompt: Please let me know ___ you need any further information.
questions.explanation: if：如果…

optionNotes.despite: despite 是介系詞，不接子句

questions.prompt: The printer on the second floor is ___ out of order.
questions.explanation: 修飾整個狀態（out of order）用副詞：currently 目前。

optionNotes.current: 形容詞不能修飾片語 out of order

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the problem.
questions.explanation: neither A nor B：動詞跟最近的 B（employees，複數）一致。

optionNotes.was: 最靠近的主詞是複數 employees
optionNotes.has been: 單數，且最近的主詞是複數

questions.prompt: This is the restaurant ___ we had our company dinner last year.
questions.explanation: 先行詞是地點，子句完整（we had our dinner）→ 關係副詞 where。

optionNotes.which: which 在子句中要當主詞或受詞，這裡子句已完整（in which 才可以）
optionNotes.what: what 不能接在先行詞後面

questions.prompt: Customers ___ purchase two items will receive a free gift.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 customers 是人，在子句中當主詞 → who。

questions.prompt: By the end of this year, we ___ more than 50 new stores.
questions.explanation: By + 未來時間點 → 未來完成式：到那時已經完成。

optionNotes.have opened: 現在完成式不搭配未來的時間點
optionNotes.opened: 過去式不符合未來時間
optionNotes.are opening: 進行式不表示「到時已完成」

questions.prompt: The proposal was rejected because it was not ___ detailed.
questions.explanation: 修飾形容詞 detailed 用副詞：sufficiently 足夠地。

optionNotes.sufficient: 形容詞不能修飾形容詞

questions.prompt: Ms. Lee prefers working from home ___ commuting to the office.
questions.explanation: prefer A to B：比起 B 更喜歡 A（不用 than）。

optionNotes.than: prefer 不搭配 than（would rather … than 才用）

questions.prompt: The new policy will take ___ on January 1.
questions.explanation: take effect：生效（effect 是名詞）。

optionNotes.effective: 形容詞，不能放在 take 後面當受詞

questions.prompt: All employees are expected to ___ the safety rules.
questions.explanation: be expected to + 原形動詞。

questions.prompt: The company's profits were ___ than expected.
questions.explanation: 有 than → 比較級 lower。

optionNotes.low: 有 than 要用比較級

questions.prompt: Mr. Patel, ___ is retiring next month, has worked here for 30 years.
questions.explanation: 先行詞是人，在子句中當主詞 → who。

optionNotes.he: 用 he 會變成兩個句子沒有連接

questions.prompt: Rarely ___ such a successful product launch.
questions.explanation: 否定意味的副詞 Rarely 放句首 → 倒裝：Rarely + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞。

questions.prompt: Please ___ in touch if you have any questions. (聯絡我們)
questions.explanation: get in touch：聯絡；keep in touch：保持聯絡。

questions.prompt: The meeting was put ___ until next week. (延後)
questions.explanation: put off = postpone 延後。

questions.prompt: I'll ___ you up at the hotel at 8. (開車去接)
questions.explanation: pick someone up：開車去接某人。

questions.prompt: Could you fill me ___ on what happened at the meeting? (告訴我最新情況)
questions.explanation: fill someone in：向某人說明（錯過的）情況。

questions.prompt: Past tense of "pay": We ___ the invoice last week.
questions.explanation: pay → paid（不是 payed）。

questions.prompt: Noun form of "deliver": The ___ will arrive tomorrow.
questions.explanation: deliver（v.）→ delivery（n.）遞送；送來的貨。

questions.prompt: Adjective form of "profit": The new store is very ___.
questions.explanation: profit（n.）→ profitable（adj.）有利潤的。

questions.prompt: Plural of "criterion": What are the ___ for the award?
questions.explanation: criterion → criteria（希臘字源的特殊複數）。

questions.prompt: We are running ___ of time. (時間快不夠了)
questions.explanation: run out of time：時間用完；run short of time 也可以。

questions.prompt: Please ___ sure the door is locked before you leave. (確認)
questions.explanation: make sure：確認；務必。

questions.passage: W: Where can I find the meeting minutes?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：會議紀錄在哪裡可以找到？
（正解：在共用資料夾裡。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Where 問地點；minutes 在這裡是「會議紀錄」不是「分鐘」。

Where 問句不能用 Yes 回答

questions.passage: M: When is the client arriving?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：客戶什麼時候到？
（正解：明天早上十點左右。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: When 問時間 → 回答時間。

questions.passage: W: Who's in charge of ordering supplies?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：誰負責訂購用品？
（正解：陳小姐負責這件事。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Who 問人 → 回答人；handle = 處理、負責。

Who 問句不能用 Yes 回答

questions.passage: M: Why is the office so cold today?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：今天辦公室怎麼這麼冷？
（正解：暖氣壞了。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Why 問原因 → 說明原因。

Why 問句不能用 Yes 回答

questions.passage: W: How long will the training take?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：培訓要多久？
（正解：大約兩小時。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: How long 問多久 → 回答一段時間。

questions.passage: M: Do you want to share a taxi to the airport?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：要不要一起搭計程車去機場？
（正解：好啊，這樣可以省錢。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Do you want to…? 是提議 → 接受或婉拒。

questions.passage: W: Can you send me the updated price list?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：可以把更新後的價目表寄給我嗎？
（正解：我馬上用 email 寄給你。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Can you…? 是請求 → 答應並說明怎麼做。

questions.passage: M: Shouldn't we order more paper?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：我們不是該多訂一些紙了嗎？
（正解：對，快用完了。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
options: I read it in the newspaper.
questions.explanation: 否定疑問句是在確認／建議：Yes + 理由。

questions.passage: W: Where did you put the contract?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：你把合約放哪裡了？
（正解：在最上面的抽屜裡。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
options: Put it on my desk, please.
questions.explanation: Where 問地點 → 回答位置。

回答做了什麼，不是位置
答非所問：對方是問你放哪，不是請你放

questions.passage: M: Is the cafeteria open on weekends?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：餐廳週末有開嗎？
（正解：只有週六有開。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Yes/No 問句也可以直接給更精確的資訊（只有週六）。

questions.passage: W: Would you mind closing the window?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：你介意把窗戶關起來嗎？
（正解：一點也不介意。＝好）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Would you mind…? 答應時要說 Not at all / No problem（不介意），說 Yes 反而是「介意」。

Yes 表示「介意」，而且答非所問

questions.passage: M: Which printer should I use?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：我應該用哪一台印表機？
（正解：門旁邊那台。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Which 問哪一個 → the one…

questions.passage: W: Hasn't the shipment arrived yet?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：貨還沒到嗎？
（正解：應該今天下午會到。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: 否定疑問句：直接說明實際情況。

questions.passage: M: How about meeting for lunch on Friday?
questions.passageTranslation:
男：週五一起吃午餐如何？
（正解：週五我可以。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: How about…? 是提議，「work for me」= 我可以、方便。

lunch 的聲音陷阱，而且是過去式

questions.passage: W: Why did the sales team miss the deadline?
questions.passageTranslation:
女：業務團隊為什麼沒趕上期限？
（正解：他們的經理病了一個禮拜。）
questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
options: Their manager was sick for a week.
questions.answer: Their manager was sick for a week.
questions.explanation: Why 問原因：回答理由（不一定要有 because）。

回答期限是哪天，不是原因
